scope: public generic and private checked named-property ASCII guards, reserved dispatch, and complete typed property-find caller
adaptation: Accept exactly ASCII letters, digits, underscore and dollar via two u64 masks, with an equivalent wrapping-subtraction lowercase fast path. Reject non-ASCII UTF-16 units before modulo-64 shifts. Validate every unit before rejecting pinned reserved spellings through length/first-unit dispatch; empty names remain accepted. After the matching reserved-length bucket is exhausted, return accepted without testing disjoint lengths. This original checked guard rejects unsupported munging rather than porting upstream code; provenance does not establish execution. The public generic body remains canonical. A private non-null STRING specialization removes only already-proven type casts and its entry guard. Its complete closed generator and complete property-find caller are independently pinned; each table entry is guarded before checked validation, and malformed late entries still reject. No public ABI or cross-call cache is introduced.
guard-location: Named instance access must not mistake raw source names for munged fields.
typed-precondition: property-find guards each entry as STRING before checked validation; query STRING guarded before typed equality; full scan including late entries
